about: Console Mode: no Update All item is blocked. Only MiSTer's Main and Linux are protected: a restore point is made before Update All runs from the app, and Updates & restore points puts one back.

entry:system_options_menu/Linux Updates.note: Console Mode runs on MiSTer's Linux, so it's protected: a restore point of Linux is made before Update All runs from the app, and Updates & restore points puts the old Linux back.

var:main_updater.note: MiSTer's Main program, menu core and cores. MiSTer's Main is protected: a restore point is made before Update All runs from the app.

var:encc_forks.note: Which MiSTer Main distribution. Whichever you pick, a restore point of MiSTer's Main is made before Update All runs from the app.
